# A component built at run time whose prop is an anonymous struct naming one
# of its type parameters is refused, with a position, on a target that copies
# a generic per instantiation.
#
# Nothing copies a component, so fyne and android emit the one declaration
# with T erased, and the struct each instantiation hands it is the package's
# `struct { v int }`, a different host type: Kotlin wrote `fun Show(w: )`,
# and fyne's literal did not compile against the erased field.
#
# Its events' parameters and its state are refused the same way. html keeps
# the generic, and bubbletea splices a stateful component per copy,
# so neither builds the component at run time and both generate it.

! sngl generate --lang go --platform fyne --out out app.sngl
stderr 'app.sngl:14:13: "show" is built while the program runs here, and its prop "w" is struct \{ v T \}'

! sngl generate --lang kotlin --platform android --out out2 app.sngl
stderr 'app.sngl:14:13: "show" is built while the program runs here'

sngl generate --platform html --out out3 app.sngl
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out4 app.sngl

# html builds an instance in the page's JavaScript whatever the language, so
# it holds genericComponents under --lang go too.
sngl generate --lang go --platform html --out out5 app.sngl

# An event's parameters and the component's own state are refused the same
# way: each is spelled in the one erased declaration.
! sngl generate --lang go --platform fyne --out out6 event.sngl
stderr 'event.sngl:18:13: "pick" is built while the program runs here, and its event @chose.s parameter is struct \{ v T \}'

! sngl generate --lang kotlin --platform android --out out7 state.sngl
stderr 'state.sngl:12:13: "keep" is built while the program runs here, and its state "w" is struct \{ v T \}'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component show[T any](w struct {
    v T
}) {
    var hits = 0
    ui.button(text="{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
}

var items = [1, 2]

ui.window(title="x") {
    for var i = items {
        show(w={v=i})
    }
}
-- event.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component pick[T any](x T, @chose(w struct {
    v T
})) {
    var hits = 0
    ui.button(text="{hits}", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
        chose({v=x})
    })
}

var items = [1, 2]
var got = 0

ui.window(title="x") {
    for var i = items {
        pick(x=i, @chose(w) { got = w.v })
    }
}
-- state.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component keep[T any](x T) {
    var w = {v=x}
    ui.button(text="b", @click { w = {v=x} })
}

var items = [1, 2]

ui.window(title="x") {
    for var i = items {
        keep(x=i)
    }
}
